lesson.cute_cat.title: Cute Cat
lesson.cute_cat.summary: Draw a friendly cat from simple curves, ears, face details and a body with a tail.
lesson.cute_cat.step.head: Let’s start with a big soft curve for the cat’s head.
lesson.cute_cat.step.ears: Now add two pointy ears, one on each side.
lesson.cute_cat.step.face: Add two eyes and a tiny smiling mouth.
lesson.cute_cat.step.body_tail: Finish with the body and a long curved tail.
lesson.cute_cat.help.head_hint: Think of a round balloon shape.
lesson.cute_cat.help.face_hint: Keep the eyes level with each other.
lesson.cute_cat.complete.face: Nice! Your cat has a face now.
lesson.cute_cat.complete.drawing: Great work. Your cat is ready!
lesson.cute_cat.coloring.freehand: Pick any colors you like. Your cat’s drawing lines will stay safe while you color.
